mapper.select: SELECT provider AS provider, COUNT(*) AS signup_count FROM users WHERE created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end} GROUP BY provider
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ssa.user_id) FROM saved_spot_archives ssa JOIN users u ON u.id = ssa.user_id WHERE ssa.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT s.name AS spot_name, COUNT(*) AS save_count FROM saved_spot_archives ssa JOIN spots s ON s.id = ssa.spot_id WHERE ssa.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
